decisions.reason: As a semi-hard cheese wheel it is very close to the firm's established cheese capabilities, and its survival beyond launch suggests management can use existing know-how and customer feedback to refine and profitably retain it.

This spicy cheese still builds on the firm's core cheese knowledge, but as a more taste-specific variant it is somewhat more vulnerable to range simplification if demand proves narrower than for standard products.

The mild creamy soft cheese fits the firm's existing dairy and cheese base well, and having been given its own page after launch indicates enough early promise for management to keep supporting and learning from it.
